final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg FROM pair_averages), trader_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(p.avg_anlycount - o.mean_pair_avg) AS avg_above_overall_mean FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.mean_pair_avg GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_above_overall_mean, avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS ratio_to_trader_type_mean FROM trader_averages
